findings.title: Avoid making XSS protection depend on deprecated environment options
findings.body: The new constructor passes autoescape through Starlette’s deprecated **env_options path; the installed implementation explicitly warns to use a preconfigured jinja2.Environment instead. Escaping works today (a script payload rendered escaped), but the change replaces direct security configuration with a deprecated forwarding API. This matters because pyproject.toml leaves FastAPI unbounded and Dockerfile installs dependencies without uv.lock. Future compatibility and continued enforcement now depend on dependency behavior; no current XSS bypass was demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Retain the explicit jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) and pass it through Jinja2Templates(env=...).
